mapper.sql: id, assignment_id AS assignmentId, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, group_id AS groupId, current_version_id AS currentVersionId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_submission ( assignment_id, owner_user_id, group_id, current_version_id ) VALUES ( #{assignmentId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{groupId}, #{currentVersionId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY owner_user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission_version v INNER JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.id = v.submission_id WHERE s.group_id = #{groupId}
